scope: Pinned immutable E11 catalogs. Constructor/source domain and actual supplied native owner graph,not universal process enumeration. RQ01/COMP01/E12 remain separate.

headless_entrypoints.rule: Validate-load owns1 local World/Core/base/cube/library/launcher definitions. MakeHeadlessCore returns Core+World and drops constructor locals;Core/World/texture/registry roots retain their actual aliases. LoadConfig replacement can overlap the initial storage;default construction upper2 storages,not a forced exact count after caller release. Further callers must supply their retained roots.

normal_source_and_flight_native_relation: Four named desktop constructor regions and Application startup/refresh bind the same resource holder types. Actual execution in this certificate is flight menu/first-game plus its auxiliary UWorld,not every interactive/headless/backend workload.
resource_holder_rule: Count distinct actual storage objects behind Core,World/registry,texture cube,Application,GUI object icons/content preview,main and optional lab viewmodel,launcher and caller roots. Current defaults alias active consumers;LoadConfig may retire a storage while another holder remains. Never multiply catalog payload by wrapper count without identity deduplication.

globals.pack_registry_image: Registry/image nested once per retained Pack;Biomes snapshot aliases the Pack registry. Active directory backing separate.

thread_rules.participation: 1 main/calling thread plus all supplied live named pool workers is conservative for this application catalog domain. Generation job guard retires its7 convenience slots/name before work credit;other readers/pins/escaped caller roots remain explicit. No foreign TLS traversal.
thread_rules.auxiliary_catalog_callers: Current watchdog/audio/fluid-summary/profiler/window-capture/weather-future work has no named E11 catalog captures;numeric TLS,OS/CRT executor threads and their process memory remain E12. Unknown caller threads require a supplied bound.

pool_rule: At most8 named pool fields and27 source-capped workers per fully initialized supplied World owner. Optional objects may be absent. Disabled capture execution does not imply no created capture pool. A component make_unique replacement can overlap its predecessor;the largest named component pool constructor adds<=8 workers under serialized default main-thread factories. Count constructing/diagnostic/additional Worlds and caller pools explicitly. These are source-profile terms for COMP01,not an implemented global thread cap or process-memory verdict.
escaped_key_rule: A16-byte key alias can preserve a registry after Pack payload destruction. Known weak candidates must match shared owner and exact registry key address. Empty-owner nonnull aliases require known fixed builtin addresses. Unknown ownership yields UNSUPPORTED,never0. Standard shared-owner/control/allocator source profile;arbitrary custom owner allocations remain unmodeled E12/caller terms.
